name: native-select
useFor: Use NativeSelect where the platform picker serves best: phones, long plain lists, forms that must work without script. Use Select for the brand's popup list. size="sm" is the 32px field.
constraints: Options styled to imitate the brand's popup
A caret that turns or moves
source: Derived from the Hoplite website's lines and type, as Input is (the site has no fields)
title: Native select
description: The browser's select dressed as the square field: a 32 percent edge on the ground, 14px ink and a 16px Phosphor caret in the quiet gray at the end; the open list is the platform's.
